answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price identity with a refundable stake plus slow-earned reputation. New agents start in a shallow pool limited to low-value tasks; only a long record of correct, attested work unlocks high-value jobs. An attacker flooding the ocean with fake identities must pay a stake for each one and wait out the slow climb, while honest agents keep the nectar of proven reliability. One proven whisper of fraud burns the stake and the identity, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes and earn nothing.
